{"headword":"ambassador","explanation":"「ambassador」在學測閱讀中常出現在外交、國際關係或品牌推廣的語境中。除了指政府派出的「大使」，在現代商業語境中常指「品牌大使」，用來代表特定組織或產品進行宣傳。","senses":[{"sense":"大使；代表（官方代表或品牌代言人）","entries":[{"pattern":"an ambassador to [country]","pos":"noun","translation":"派駐於某國的大使","explanation":"使用介系詞 to 表示派遣的目的地。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The newly appointed <target>ambassador</target> <pattern>to</pattern> France worked hard to improve the trade relationship between the two nations.","translation":"新任命的法國大使努力改善兩國之間的貿易關係。"}]},{"pattern":"an ambassador of [country/organization]","pos":"noun","translation":"某國/某組織的大使","explanation":"使用介系詞 of 表示所屬關係。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>ambassador</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Japan shared a vision for global peace during the international conference in New York.","translation":"日本大使在紐約的國際會議上分享了對全球和平的願景。"}]},{"pattern":"a brand ambassador","pos":"noun","translation":"品牌大使；代言人","explanation":"指被公司聘請來增加產品知名度或提升品牌形象的名人或專業人士。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous basketball player was chosen as a <target>brand ambassador</target> because his healthy lifestyle matches the company's image.","translation":"這名著名的籃球員被選為品牌大使，因為他健康的生活方式符合公司的形象。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"representative","pos":"noun","translation":"代表","explanation":"較為泛用的代表稱呼"},{"word":"envoy","pos":"noun","translation":"使節；特使","explanation":"較正式且通常指臨時性的外交代表"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ambas (大使) + 詞尾 -ador (人)","related":[{"word":"embassy","pos":"noun","translation":"大使館","explanation":"大使館是大使工作和代表國家在國外的地點。"}]}}

{"headword":"ambition","explanation":"「ambition」在描述人物特質、職業規劃或社會成功時是高頻詞彙。注意它在句中可作主詞或受詞，且常與 achieve, pursue 或 lack 搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"雄心；抱負；野心（強烈想要成功的渴望）","entries":[{"pattern":"have the ambition to do sth.","pos":"noun","translation":"有志於做某事","explanation":"後接不定詞，描述一個人內心強烈的目標或渴望。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite growing up in a poor village, the young girl had the <target>ambition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> become a world-class doctor.","translation":"儘管在一個貧困的村莊長大，這個年輕女孩有志於成為一名世界級的醫生。"}]},{"pattern":"pursue one's ambition","pos":"noun","translation":"追求某人的抱負","explanation":"常用動詞 pursue 表示對目標的持續追求。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students leave their hometowns after graduation to pursue their <target>ambitions</target> in the big city.","translation":"許多學生就學畢業後離開家鄉，前往大城市追求他們的抱負。"}]},{"pattern":"lack ambition","pos":"noun","translation":"缺乏抱負","explanation":"常用於描述一個人缺乏動力或對未來沒有明確目標。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The manager complained that his new employee seemed to lack <target>ambition</target>, as he never tried to improve his skills.","translation":"經理抱怨他的新員工似乎缺乏抱負，因為他從未嘗試提升自己的技能。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"aspiration","pos":"noun","translation":"志向；抱負","explanation":"較為正面且較高的目標"},{"word":"drive","pos":"noun","translation":"動力；積極性","explanation":"強調達成目標的內在推動力"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"apathy","pos":"noun","translation":"冷漠；缺乏興趣","explanation":null}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ambition (抱負) + 形容詞字尾 -ious","related":[{"word":"ambitious","pos":"adjective","translation":"有野心的；雄心勃勃的","explanation":"描述一個人渴望權力、金錢或成功的特質。"}]}}

comment: Senses 2 and 3 are logically flawed. 'Berry' is not a general metaphor for 'small things' (Sense 2), and 'the berry on top' is not a standard English idiom; the correct idiom is 'the cherry on top'.
